meta.title: Home | The Hague Natural Health Centre | Holistic Health in The Hague
meta.description: The Hague Natural Health Centre is holistic health centre offering alternative, natural therapies including accupuncture, homeopathy, ayurdeva, reiki, yoga, vedic meditation, EMDR, counselling, nutrition, psychology, tissue salts, bach flower essences, men's and women's circles, Trauma Sensitive Yoga (TCTSY) and talks, courses, workshops and events. Contact Founder and Homeopath Sandra Delgado Quist for more information.

nature.title: NATURE INSPIRED HEALTHCARE
nature.lead: We believe that nature is the key to truly restoring health and rediscovering what it feels like to be relaxed and full of energy,
nature.text: The demands of our busy lives and meeting social obligations can drain our energy sources, leaving us fatigued or unwell. If you want to improve how you manage the hustle and bustle and enjoy life again, get to know our natural health centre.

help.title: How can we help?
paragraphs: Our bodies have self-healing power which is automatic. When we are under constant stress, this natural ability to self-heal becomes challenged and our body starts to give signals that it is unwell in the form of symptoms like pain or mental distress. Often people tend to ignore the little signals until they become dis-eases and more difficult to overcome.
We offer various natural therapies under one roof that approach disease from a holistic perspective - addressing mind, body and spirit.

quote.label: What clients say
quote.text: "At last! A forward thinking, holistic clinic, with a luxurious feel, where the practitioners actually work together to get you better."

engage.title: How to engage?
engage.text1: If you know which type of therapy you would like to choose, please contact the therapist directly.
engage.text2: If you would like to discuss various options or have questions, feel free to contact one of the therapists below.

people.name: Sandra Delgado Quist
people.text: Sandra is founder of The Hague Natural Health Centre and an accredited Homeopath, Reiki teacher & practitioner. Sandra is passionate about teaching and empowering people to take control of their own health.

people.name: Ira Sloof
people.text: Ira is an accredited acupuncturist and herbalist by the Zhong. She loves helping people overcome a wide variety of issues, contributing to the activation of their Life Energy (Qi). Being involved in this work fills her with joy.

people.name: Audrey Dickinson
people.text: Audrey is a trained nutritionist specialising in hormonal and vaginal health. She enjoys supporting people with manageable nutrition plans that are not overwhelming to people trying to make dietary changes.

accessible.title: ACCESSIBLE TO ALL
accessible.text: True health begins at home. In ancient times our medicine grew in the garden and we understood how to use plants as medicine. We have lost our connection to nature and our inner wisdom. As part of our commitment to the local community, we offer regular events discussing topics that affect many. These small gatherings aim to provide you with knowledge about various options that can help you to take control of your own health.
